Requirements and recovery

Live upgrade requires Longhorn 1.12.2 or later as the source, Kubernetes 1.34+, and healthy RW replicas on at least two eligible hosts. Single-host, ublk and sharded configurations use offline upgrade.

Back up the V2 volumes and leave disk space for rebuilding volume copies. Do not expand volumes or move running VMs until all host upgrades finish and the volumes are healthy.

The host timeout is 60 minutes. It does not apply while waiting for healthy volumes. Pausing lets the current host finish, and does not roll back the manager or storage version.

Longhorn retries failed hosts up to five times. Resolve the reported error first. Pausing and resuming does not reset the retries. Resetting the controller is a manual recovery step in Longhorn.
